flows.description: Cold editor startup before a project is opened.

metrics.rationale: Startup may enumerate bounded project summaries but must not hydrate every large-project resource.
Asset details belong to the on-demand library after project selection.
Cold startup must not read project behavior bodies.

flows.description: Reopen creator-performance-v1 and render its initial editor shell.

metrics.rationale: The v1 reopen workload always consumes the committed 32 KiB manifest payload.
The canonical project manifest is decoded once per reopen.
The renderer-owned asset query uses a 64-record page.
Only the active behavior may be hydrated during initial editor restore.
Recovery state is a single versioned snapshot, not a per-resource scan.

flows.description: Browse and scroll the 2,048-asset library and working palette.

metrics.rationale: The release corpus fixes exactly 2,048 assets so under-processing cannot satisfy the workload.
Asset-library IPC/query pages stay bounded at the renderer page size.
Working-palette preview hydration is chunked into 64-reference requests.
Service-owned group summaries expose at most eight preview references.
Offscreen assets are deferred until their virtual window is requested.

flows.description: Open, search, and resolve the large behavior/reference corpus.

metrics.rationale: The corpus covers a non-trivial mixed visual and TypeScript behavior set.
Every v1 behavior carries sixteen deterministic references.
Reference search uses the canonical 32-record page size.
Resolve-all hydration honors the main-process 64-reference boundary.
Listing and virtual scrolling operate on summaries, not every source body.

flows.description: Validate the valid corpus and its deterministic 64-fault variant.

metrics.rationale: The validation workload includes one project, eight maps, 4,096 objects, 2,048 assets, 512 behaviors, and 8,192 references.
One validation request performs one owner traversal instead of repeating per panel.
The invalid variant fixes diagnostic cardinality for comparable runs.
Exactly one actionable diagnostic per injected fault proves result conformance and prevents missing or duplicate fan-out.
The linear traversal ceiling covers maps, objects, assets, behaviors, and references with bounded overhead.

flows.description: Persist one changed map and its project revision atomically.

metrics.rationale: The fixture save mutates one map so amplification is measurable.
A map revision installs only map, project, and integrity-lock targets.
The durable map transaction has prepared, map, project, and lock phases.
Normal incremental save must not copy the full large project.

flows.description: Compile the selected map and start a local playtest session.

metrics.rationale: Playtest start packages only the selected map.
The fixture intentionally references the complete behavior corpus.
512 behavior sources at 4 KiB each fix the complete v1 compile input workload.
A session may progress through queued, starting, and running once.

flows.description: Assemble all eight fixture maps into verified runtime map packages.

metrics.rationale: Package coverage includes every map in creator-performance-v1.
Package consumes the complete fixed asset corpus before output amplification is measured.
Package consumes the complete fixed behavior corpus before output amplification is measured.
2,048 synthetic assets at 4 KiB each fix the v1 asset payload.
Asset, behavior, map-section, manifest, and integrity files remain linearly bounded.
Assembly plus integrity verification may each traverse the selected corpus once.

flows.description: Promote the packaged corpus into one verified local Ship artifact.

metrics.rationale: Ship consumes exactly the package output without silently dropping maps.
The final inventory includes packaged content plus bounded host metadata/runtime files.
A 64 MiB ceiling detects accidental source/cache/runtime duplication for the 8 MiB asset corpus.
Ship atomically promotes one verified work directory to its final artifact.
One durable inventory verification proves the promoted artifact.
